tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. Bangalore University shall not be responsible for non accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable. Conditional tenders will not be accepted

The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and Bangalore University will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable
Bangalore University is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka public Procurement Portal
The EMD & Tender processing fee shall be paid through Karnataka public procurement portal only as per the e-procurement rules
EMD should be paid as specified in the tender document available in Karnataka public procurement portal and if the EMD is not paid the tender will be rejected
The Tenderers need to register with Karnataka public procurement portal and to obtain user ID and Password for participating in the Tender process
The Bangalore University reserves the rights to Accept or Reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
No subsequent correspondence regarding price quoted will be entertained
Bidders should abide by other terms & conditions as prescribed in relevant KTPP standard tender document and KTPP Rules and KTPP Act
Bidder should abide by all the terms and conditions as per tender document
Tender received without adequate details will be rejected
It is suggested that the PDF Files to be uploaded should be made using the minimum readable appropriate resolution

For availing exemption for payment of EMD: The tenderers should be registered with National Small Industries Development Corporation Ltd. (NSIC) under a single point vendor registration. They should upload Government Purchase Enlistment Certificate from NSIC which will be verified online in the e-procurement portal. The exemption and relaxation in EMD is subject to the validity & acceptance of their registration certificate on the date of opening of tender. Only Udyam Registration Certificate will not be accepted for EMD exemption
The Bidder shall be OEM or Authorized System Integrator/ Partners / Dealer of OEM having authorization to supply the product
Tenderer shall not furnish the Financial Tender along with the Technical Tender. A Technical Tender containing any details of Financial Tender shall be declared as non-responsive.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Previous Supply orders and work completion certificate issued by previous customers must be enclosed

(Supply Orders as well as Satisfactory performance report from previous customers to be furnished)

Details of Service Center of the bidder and service support team for the equipment in Bengaluru

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Turnover of the Tenderer should not be less than Rs. 06 Lakhs (Rupees Six Lakh only) for the last three preceding Financial years (i.e. Financial Year 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover Certificate duly attested by Chartered Accountant to be furnished

The Bidder should not be blacklisted by the Government of Karnataka or any of its department/agency or by Central / any other State/UT Government or its department/ agency for the last three years
